name: HIPERX
description:
## Description

"Speaker system using Italian solid walnut.A 12.5cm cone type woofer made of polypropylene cone is mounted in the low range.A 2.5cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.Butterworth type is used for the network part.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system.Italian solid walnut is used for the plate material. It is made through a luxurious process of cutting 38mm thick walnut material to 30mm. The structure is also acoustically examined. The use of thick solid wood suppresses unnecessary squealing, and uses a six sided round edge to eliminate diffraction effects and a bass reflex duct to improve transient characteristics.It is finished by hand by Michaelangelo Dara Fontana.There was a special speaker stand as an option sold separately."

name: HIPER3X
description:
## Description

"Speaker system using Italian solid walnut.A 20cm cone type woofer made of polypropylene cone is mounted in the low range.The mid-range features a 3.9cm soft dome mid-range, and the high-range features a 2.5cm soft dome tweeter.The network section uses a secondary link Witz-Riley type.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system.Italian solid walnut is used for the plate material. It is made through a luxurious process of cutting 38mm thick walnut material to 30mm. The structure is also acoustically examined. The use of thick solid wood suppresses unnecessary squealing, and uses a six sided round edge to eliminate diffraction effects and a bass reflex duct to improve transient characteristics.It is finished by hand by Michaelangelo Dara Fontana."

name: REFERENCE100
description:
## Description

"A bookshelf type speaker system with a bass reflex port at the bottom.A 13cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.This unit uses a paper cone that has been doped as a diaphragm.A 2.7cm dome-shaped tweeter is installed in the high range.A textile dome diaphragm is used for the diaphragm.The crossover frequency is set to 1.950Hz, which is lower than the average 2-way speaker. This minimizes the distortion caused by the high frequency coverage of the woofer and enables wide-clear mid-range playback.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system.In Reference100, a woofer is laid out in the upper part. The top plate near the woofer vibrates to prevent the decrease of the low range. The bass reflex port is laid out in the bottom part away from the woofer to enable low range playback with sound field feeling.The exterior is rough with a 6-sided veneer finish made of natural wood mahogany.There was a speaker stand as an option sold separately.The pole of this stand also has a mahogany veneer finish."
